description: Passages à niveau is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Réseau Ferré de France. Passages à niveau permettant le franchissement piéton ou routier d’une ligne ferroviaire à son niveau.Le fichier contient: le code de la ligne sur laquelle est situé le passage à niveau le type de passage à niveau le statut "prioritaire" du passage à niveau (circulation importante de trains et de véhicules) la position WGS84 du passage ... Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Routes, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 474 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2014-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
